text:
Maya Johnson: drafting 0.10.1 release notes now. small patch release: canary routing weight fixes, Dedicated autoscale tuning, and documentation clarifications. opened draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4120 :memo:

Carlos Vega: thanks Maya. can we surface a short known issue about alias TTL and canary propagation? some customers saw 1-3s of old routing after label updates.

Maya Johnson: yes. suggested user-facing line: "Intermittent alias propagation: after changing routing weights, a small fraction of requests may see prior routing for up to a few seconds. If you need strict consistency, use explicit model ids." keeps it short.

Aisha Khan: add a one-line ops note for the release notes: "Fix: reduced alias cache TTL and added eventual-consistency doc with mitigation patterns (pin model ids, use canary fallback)." Also create a link to /guides/deployments/alias-consistency.md

Tom B.: for autoscale, let's call out the mitigation: "During capacity rebalancing Dedicated pools may temporarily queue requests. Mitigation: enable soft-burst capacity and set resize grace period to 30s." Also include a short code snippet for the terraform var.

Maya Johnson: good call. snippet for terraform: ```hcl
resource "redwood_dedicated_pool" "prod" {
  name = "prod-gpu"
  min_size = 2
  max_size = 20
  autoscale {
    soft_burst = true
    resize_grace_period = 30
  }
}
``` keep that in snippets section.

Carlos Vega: also add a QA checklist item in PR: run synthetic burst test at 2000 rps for 2 minutes against Dedicated pool with autoscale enabled. I'll add a note to the PR description.

Aisha Khan: wording suggestion for changelog bullet: "Fixed alias propagation and adjusted Dedicated autoscale defaults to reduce transient queueing. See migration notes for pinning and fallback patterns." short and user-friendly.

Maya Johnson: perfect. Docs Bot: please add changelog template tag and note to link to /guides/deployments/alias-consistency.md and /guides/migration/autoscale-best-practices.md

Docs Bot: Changelog template tag added to PR #4120; linked guides requested.

Tom B.: I'll follow up with the examples PR to drop the terraform snippet into /examples/infrastructure/ and add the autoscale best-practices doc.

Maya Johnson: thanks team. two approvals and we'll merge after CI. tagging @Carlos Vega @Aisha Khan for approvals.

Carlos Vega: approving now.

Aisha Khan: approving. merge when green. :rocket:
